list_entry.title: A survey taken ten years ago

A.explanation: Since the statements compare the view of residents in area L at two different times, the view of residents of adjacent areas is not relevant.

B.explanation: This provides the anticipated change necessary for the living conditions in area L to decline in absolute terms while improving in relative terms to the rest of the country.

C.explanation: Since this statement applies equally to both surveys, it cannot explain the difference in attitude between them.

D.explanation: While this might contribute to an explanation for why the living conditions did not improve. But this does not explain why residents are now dissatisfied with their living conditions, since it does not imply that living conditions declined.

E.explanation: Even if it is further assumed that residents are now aware of how their living conditions compare with the national average, this only deepens the paradox.
